Hero_Desc_Mago:
A kind werebeast who enjoys protecting and taking care of her little animal friends.
Mago's little friends are well-known for listening to her.
Album_Hate_Mago: Fights between friends. Groups of three or more.
Album_Mago1: Mago is a werebeast living peacefully on the outskirts of the village. She has a gentle personality and gets along with the animals and beasts in the forest. She even hates minor conflicts.
Album_Mago2: This dislike for conflicts is why Mago has lived alone on the outskirts for a long period of time. This might explain why it's so easy for her to act shy or awkward, not only with other races, but even with her own kind.
Album_Mago3: I've seen the average animal usually listen to Mago when they go near her. Compared to her awkward communications with the werebeasts or the other races, it's pretty amazing. Or perhaps, is that exactly why she gets along with the animals so well?
Album_Mago4: I suggested to Mago that if she acted the same way towards the werebeast and the sprites as she does with the animals, it might be easier to befriend them. Mago looked pleased, as if she had an epiphany.
Album_Mago5: After taking my advice, Mago began talking more cheerfully to her friends. I felt rather proud.
Album_Mago6: A few werebeast came to me with strange gripe about Mago. Even though I told them that's not how friends should act, I was still displeased with the other werebeasts who couldn't understand Mago.
Album_Mago7: I went to check on Mago, and she greeted me warmly. But suddenly, she tried to feed me chow and put a leash on me. Apparently, she had misunderstood my advice, thinking it meant "treat your friends like animals." I had to spend the entire day tied up in the yard just to clear up the misunderstanding.
LoveHero_Mago: Let's go take care of our friends in danger!
LoveHeroCancel_Mago:
Are we done now?
Uh... It's fine...
There are many abandoned friends like me
at the ranch.
Food_ChefNote_Mago_Hate1: After seeing this dish, Mago began tearing up, lamenting that her sweet plant friends from the forest had fallen in such a cold, twisted way.
Food_ChefNote_Mago_Hate2: As soon as she saw the dish, Mago fainted, calling it an indescribable horror.
Food_ChefNote_Mago_Like1: Because of her love for nature, Mago is usually very picky about her food. She surprisingly likes this dish even when the ingredients cannot be immediately inferred.
Food_ChefNote_Mago_Like2:
Despite her aura, it looks like Mago likes this dish. 
She ordered it in bulk, saying she wanted it to be delivered to the farm where she was going to share it with her friends.
Food_ChefNote_Mago_Like3: Mago accidentally spilled the powder on the table and kept on licking the table.
Food_ChefNote_Mago_Like4: Saying she wanted to share them with her friends at her farm, I packed a few songpyeon for her.
Food_ChefNote_Mago_Like5: She only ate the leftovers after first feeding her little companion to fullness.
Food_ChefNote_Mago_Like6: Seeing the log-shaped food reminded Mago of little friends who live in log houses. She called it cute.
Food_ChefNote_Mago_Like7: As soon as Mago took a bite, her little friends rushed over and devoured it. Mago seemed a bit embarrassed then.
Food_ChefNote_Mago_Like8: I was frustrated to see how slow Mago ate... As she licked little by little, I noticed her tongue moved faster than expected. She devoured in no time.
Food_ChefNote_Mago_Like9: Mago pondered whether her small friends could eat the 'beast candy'. The little ones didn't discriminate and eagerly ate the candies.

LoveLetter_Mago: How are things with you, Master?The weather at my ranch has been lovely lately. The big trees provide cool shade, and the gentle breeze carries the scent of flowers. Resting under the shade feels so peaceful.While relaxing with my friends, I couldn't help but think of you. Everyone here misses you, and so do I. That's why I'm writing this letter. I'd love to see you soon.
LoveCall_Mago:
Hello, Master. I am sorry to call so suddenly.
The animal friends at our ranch kept pleading that they wanted to see you...
so I called to let them hear your voice, at least for a little while.

Hehe, hearing your voice seems to have cheered them up.
Oh, everyone, wait! Do not crowd so close! Honestly...
Ah, I am sorry. They keep trying to lick the phone...!
Phew, the animals seem to miss you even more than I expected.
Lately, they have hardly eaten and seem to have no energy...
...So, could you perhaps visit the ranch?
Seeing my friends like this has left me... a little dispirited too.
Oh, you will come? Thank you! Then I will be waiting.
The animal friends, and I... will be very happy.
Affinity_Mago_EP01_001: Master! Won't you come visit me and my ranch friends sometime?
Affinity_Mago_EP01_002: I'll see how things go and visit if I can.
Affinity_Mago_EP01_003: Really? Thank you! I'd love for my ranch friends to get a taste of your cooking!
Affinity_Mago_EP01_004: That might be difficult. I've been so busy lately...
Affinity_Mago_EP01_005: Er... that's too bad. I'll just have to get as much takeout as I can.
Affinity_Mago_EP01_006: Me? Go where? Do I look like I've got nothing else to do?
Affinity_Mago_EP01_007: I get that you're busy, but why do you have to be so rude?!
Affinity_Mago_EP02_001: I hope the Order grows. Then we can have more banquet halls like this everywhere!
Affinity_Mago_EP02_002: That would be great. Please help me make that happen!
Affinity_Mago_EP02_003: Of course! I'll do my best to help you!
Affinity_Mago_EP02_004: It'd be meaningless if I didn't serve everyone myself.
Affinity_Mago_EP02_005: You seem to think very highly of yourself.
Affinity_Mago_EP02_007: Oh? You weren't thinking of expanding if things went well here? That's a shame.
Affinity_Mago_EP03_001: The food here is so delicious! You only use clean, natural ingredients, right?
Affinity_Mago_EP03_002: Right. We have the cleanest food in Elias.
Affinity_Mago_EP03_003: That's amazing! I'll definitely come often!
Affinity_Mago_EP03_004: Not really. You can't make food without seasoning.
Affinity_Mago_EP03_005: Aw, I see... that's too bad. As long as it tastes good, I suppose...
Affinity_Mago_EP03_006: The secret ingredient is a bit of TLC.
Affinity_Mago_EP03_007: That's quite the brag there! You just don't want to give away your secret, do you?
Affinity_Mago_EP04_001: Werebeasts and elves are always at odds. It'd be great if we could get along...
Affinity_Mago_EP04_002: It's inevitable because they're mindless tech girl bosses and untamed tree huggers.
Affinity_Mago_EP04_003: Girl Boss? Tree hugger? Whatever they mean, they don't sound nice...
Affinity_Mago_EP04_004: I'll talk to the elves and reason with them.
Affinity_Mago_EP04_005: You'll talk to the elves? They're known for being stubborn, so thank you for offering to help!
Affinity_Mago_EP04_006: I'll talk to the werebeasts and reason with them.
Affinity_Mago_EP04_007:
You'll talk to the werebeasts? It kinda bothers me to hear you say that,
probably because you're talking about my kin, but if that's what you think, then so be it.
Affinity_Mago_EP05_001: Buildings are popping up everywhere nowadays and many forests are disappearing. I'm worried about the future of the forests.
Affinity_Mago_EP05_002: Our future selves will deal with that environmental pollution somehow.
Affinity_Mago_EP05_003: That's easy for you to say because you'll be long gone by the time that comes along, isn't it?!
Affinity_Mago_EP05_004: It is important to strike a balance between development and nature preservation.
Affinity_Mago_EP05_005: Am I being overly protective? Or have the building developers crossed the line?
Affinity_Mago_EP05_006: Forests are there to be used. Don't worry about it.
Affinity_Mago_EP05_007: You aren't saying that because the land you have speculated on has been developed, are you...?
Affinity_Mago_EP06_001: My animal friends seem to have gotten sick. I'm worried because they're in a lot of pain.
Affinity_Mago_EP06_002: The younger ones are more vulnerable. Take good care of them.
Affinity_Mago_EP06_003: I will! I hope they get better soon...
Affinity_Mago_EP06_004: You have to get sick to develop immunities.
Affinity_Mago_EP06_005: What? You're making it sound like it's a good thing to be sick. Do you want to get sick too, Master?
Affinity_Mago_EP06_006: Can't you cure them with magic?
Affinity_Mago_EP06_007: I don't think there's a need to use magic when there are simple, effective treatments available.
Affinity_Mago_EP07_001: Why do sprites want to ride on every big animal they see? It took a lot to get them to back off.
Affinity_Mago_EP07_002: Is there a reason they shouldn't ride on them?
Affinity_Mago_EP07_003: Is there a reason they should ride them?
Affinity_Mago_EP07_004: Do you look after grown-up animals too, Mago?
Affinity_Mago_EP07_005: Sometimes? Some of them grow attached to the ranch and they have a hard time leaving.
Affinity_Mago_EP07_006: What's the line for which animals can be ridden? Is it okay to ride a werebeast?
Affinity_Mago_EP07_007: Why... would you want to ride a werebeast? You're so weird, Master!
Affinity_Mago_EP08_001: My ranch is plagued with flies, and it's a real pain. Urgh... I wish they would go away!
Affinity_Mago_EP08_002: Flies aren't friends that need looking after?
Affinity_Mago_EP08_003: Huh? Ah... uhhh... f-flies... aren't animals... so... waaah!!
Affinity_Mago_EP08_004: Try getting some spiders or something. They are good at catching bugs.
Affinity_Mago_EP08_005: You keep a spider in the corner of your house? Eww, gross!
Affinity_Mago_EP08_006: Here's some insecticide. Try it out. Jubee absolutely hates it.

Affinity_Mago_EP09_001: Is it not right to treat my animal friends and werebeast friends the same?
Affinity_Mago_EP09_002: What's the difference between animals and werebeasts?
Affinity_Mago_EP09_003:
Hmm... there isn't really that big a difference.
It's just a matter of how much they have been affected by Yggdrasil, I guess?

Affinity_Mago_EP09_005: They may look alike, but they're not the same! Oh, maybe that's why I should treat them differently!
Affinity_Mago_EP09_006: They're all so fluffy. I just wanna pet them.
Affinity_Mago_EP09_007: Really? Wait, don't just pet me all of a sudden! But... that feels good... oh, um... mmm...
Affinity_Mago_EP10_001: Are you enjoying the things I've been sending you from my ranch?

Affinity_Mago_EP10_006: I'm thankful, but are you sure you're okay sending me eggs?
Affinity_Mago_EP10_007: Ah, it's fine, those are the unfertilized ones. Feel free to enjoy them.
Affinity_Mago_EP11_001: Phew. I wish our animal friends would be a little more docile when they're sick.
